components.name: Button
components.summary: Runs an action; the label is always a verb in sentence case ("Confirmă", "Trimite reamintire"), never "OK".

components.name: IconButton
components.summary: A square button carrying a single Lucide icon; label is required and becomes the accessible name and the native tooltip.

components.name: Input
components.summary: Single-line text entry; wrap it in FormField for the label, helper and error.

components.name: Textarea
components.summary: Multi-line text entry for notes and messages; same states as Input.

components.name: Select
components.summary: Pick one value from a short list; a custom listbox, never the native .

components.name: Combobox
components.summary: Type to filter and pick one or many values — the search field for long lists (clients, services, staff).

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: An independent yes/no choice, or one of several in a list; supports indeterminate for "select all" headers.

components.name: Radio
components.summary: One choice from a small set, all options visible; use RadioGroup, which renders the fieldset, legend and error.

components.name: Toggle
components.summary: An on/off setting that takes effect immediately (no Save button); role switch.

components.name: SegmentedControl
components.summary: Switch between two to five views of the same content (Zi / Săptămână / Resurse; Listă / Calendar).

components.name: FormField
components.summary: The wrapper every form control sits in: label, required marker, helper text and error message, wired with id and aria-describedby.

components.name: DatePicker
components.summary: Choose a date, a date range or a time; weeks start on Monday in every language.

components.name: FileUpload
components.summary: A drop zone plus a file list with per-file progress, success and error.

components.name: SlotPicker
components.summary: Free start times for a service and a person, as a grid of buttons; taken times stay visible, disabled and struck through, so people understand the day.

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: Switch between sibling sections of one record or page; the active tab has an ink label and a 2px primary underline.

components.name: DataTable
components.summary: The one table for every list of records: sorting, filters, selection, row actions, bulk bar, pagination, empty and loading — and a list layout on narrow screen…

components.name: Schedule
components.summary: The calendar grid behind every time-based view: day (one column), week (seven day columns) and resources (one column per person, room or chair), with the peach…

components.name: Agenda
components.summary: The day as a list — for the Today screen and for phones — with the peach "now" line between what's done and what's next, and the appointment in progress highli…

components.name: Kanban
components.summary: Cards in stages — the CRM pipeline, the Projects board.

components.name: Timeline
components.summary: Stages of a project as bars across weeks, with the peach "Azi" line and milestones.

components.name: Stat
components.summary: One number with its label, an optional change against a named period and a short hint.

components.name: BarChart
components.summary: Columns for periods or days, horizontal bars for categories ranked by size.

components.name: LineChart
components.summary: A measure over time — revenue per month — with an optional grey comparison (last year) and the running period in peach.

components.name: Pagination
components.summary: Move through pages of a list: range ("21–40 din 248"), rows per page, page numbers with gaps, previous/next.

components.name: StatusPill
components.summary: The state of a record in one or two words, with an icon or dot — colour is never the only signal.

components.name: StatusDot
components.summary: A small mark beside a label for live or presence state ("Acum, în cabinetul 2", "Offline").

components.name: Badge
components.summary: Counts and very short labels: unread counts, "Nou", plan tier.

components.name: Avatar
components.summary: A person or business: photo, or initials on avatar-bg; AvatarGroup stacks several with a "+n" remainder.

components.name: Tooltip
components.summary: A short label for an icon-only control or a truncated value, on hover and keyboard focus (400ms delay); never essential information.

components.name: Menu
components.summary: A list of actions opened from a trigger — the kebab on rows, "Creează", account menus.

components.name: Dialog
components.summary: A modal decision that blocks the page: confirm, a short form, a destructive choice.

components.name: Drawer
components.summary: A side panel over the current list for a record's detail or a longer form; full screen under 640px with a back arrow.

components.name: Toast
components.summary: A brief confirmation after an action, with "Anulează" (undo) whenever the action can be reversed.

components.name: EmptyState
components.summary: What a screen shows when there is nothing to show: one Lucide icon in a quiet plate, a title, one sentence, the next action — no illustrations.

components.name: Notice
components.summary: An inline message inside a page, form or panel — a sign-in error, an expired invitation, a plan notice — with an icon, a title, one or two sentences and option…

components.name: AttentionList
components.summary: "Au nevoie de tine" — the few things that need a person now, each with its own action, at the top of every app's Today screen.

components.name: Skeleton
components.summary: Placeholder shapes while content loads; match the layout that is coming so nothing jumps.

components.name: ProgressBar
components.summary: Progress of a task the user started (import, export, upload, setup).

components.name: UsageMeter
components.summary: Consumption against a plan limit, shown calmly: used, what is left, a warning near the limit, a controlled block at the limit, and the upgrade.

components.name: Kbd
components.summary: Keyboard keys in menus, tooltips and the command palette.

components.name: CommandPalette
components.summary: Search and run anything from anywhere — pages, people, records, commands — with ⌘K / Ctrl+K.

components.name: ThemeSwitcher
components.summary: Light / Dark / System — the three options every Ventora surface offers.

components.name: LanguageSwitcher
components.summary: Choose the interface language; each language is named in itself (Română, English, Français, Español, Deutsch).

components.name: AppShell
components.summary: The frame of every app: Spine on the left, ContextBar on top, the content (PageHeader + Sheet) in the middle — and a bottom nav under 640px.

components.name: Spine
components.summary: The app's navigation: app name (click to return to the Hub launcher), grouped items, an optional footer (usually a compact UsageMeter), collapse control — and…

components.name: ContextBar
components.summary: The top bar of an app: business switcher, search (opens the CommandPalette, shows ⌘K), "Creează", notifications, account.

components.name: PageHeader
components.summary: The page's title block inside the content: optional breadcrumbs, title, one-line description, meta pills, actions, tabs.

components.name: Sheet
components.summary: The working surface: a sheet panel with a hairline edge on the canvas, holding forms, settings and content; SheetSection splits it with a heading.

components.name: Logo
components.summary: The official Ventora logo files, embedded exactly as supplied: the mark, and the full logo with its own "VENTORA" wordmark.

components.name: GrowthSlot
components.summary: The container an app puts in a permitted place (the side column of "Azi", a settings page).

components.name: RecommendationCard
components.summary: One recommendation in a page, tied to what the business already does.

components.name: RecommendationLabel

components.name: UpgradeDialog

components.name: DiscoveryTooltip
components.summary: A one-off hint next to the thing it explains: an arrow to the element, a short title, one sentence, "Am înțeles" and, optionally, "Vezi cum funcționează".

components.name: HubRecommendation
components.summary: Recommendations in the Hub notifications panel.

components.name: RuleBuilder

components.name: AccessBadge
components.summary: The label for an app's access state, used on AppTiles and in the owner's access settings.

components.name: OrgSwitcher
components.summary: Shows the business you are working in and your role; switches between the businesses you belong to.

components.name: NotificationsPanel
components.summary: The bell in the ContextBar and its panel: All / Unread, mark all as read, settings, items with person or app icon.

components.name: AccountMenu

components.name: Icon
